data.one_liner: Request and write reviews and open store listings for Android, iOS, and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to prompt users for in-app reviews, open store listings or review pages, and look up app IDs on Android, iOS, and macOS. It bridges native APIs like Google Play In-App Review and SKStoreReviewController directly to Flutter.
use_when: You want to prompt users for in-app reviews without leaving your app.
You need to deep-link users directly to your Play Store or App Store page.
You need to fetch Apple App IDs dynamically using a bundle ID.
avoid_when: You need support for Windows, Linux, or Web platforms.
You want a reactive or state-managed approach to reviews.
strengths: Native implementation using Pigeon for type safety without extra dependencies like url_launcher or http.
Supports Android test mode via FakeReviewManager.
Supports SwiftUI bridge for requesting reviews on iOS 16+ and macOS 14+.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android, iOS, and macOS).
Subject to platform limitations (e.g., Apple limits review prompts to 3 times per year in production).
data.setup_notes: Android requires the app to be published on the Play Store for real review flows, or testMode enabled. iOS and macOS may require proper entitlements or provisioning profiles.
